preprocessing: grayscale -> pad to square with black -> resize -> 3 channels -> ImageNet normalisation
mask_threshold_tuned_on: out-of-fold masks (567 images), best average Dice

possible_area.decision: off: failed the out-of-fold check, test set not opened
possible_area.hit_rule: at least half of the area is on the true lesion

decision_rule: average the models; malignant if P(malignant) >= malignant_threshold, else the more likely of normal / benign; mask = averaged probability map, enlarged smoothly, thresholded, cleaned
